alt: Summary table of four GI hormones - gastrin, secretin, cholecystokinin (CCK) and gastric inhibitory peptide (GIP) - with the tissue that secretes each, its stimulus, target organ and response. Motilin, GLP-1, VIP, somatostatin and ghrelin are not included, and the table contains several typographic errors.
